patterns.message: From outside src/app, import only the modules at its root (program.ts, view.tsx, layer.ts).
Test-only code: fast-check, *.test_*.ts files (arbitraries, contracts, test support) and @fgaudo/effect-tea/testing may only be imported by *.test.ts and *.test_*.ts files.
Relative imports stay within their part of the project: reach another part through its alias (#app/…, #domain/…, #libs/…, #infrastructure/…).
An entrypoint imports from src/app its root modules (program.ts, view.tsx, layer.ts) and the adapters it picks (<service>.<backing>.ts); nothing else.

A program knows only its own folder: an import never goes up to a parent or across to a sibling (another child, another service), except to a program of its parent's programs/ (../../programs/<program>/).
Inside src/app, files reach each other through relative imports, downwards; the alias is only for the root's programs/, from deeper than ../../.
A parent reaches a child, and a program a program of programs/, only through the modules at its root (program.ts, view.tsx, layer.ts).
Adapters (<service>.<backing>.ts) are imported only by a layer.ts, an entrypoint or their own test: a program uses its services.
